articles.title: Bitcoin researchers propose quantum fix that would not crowd out transactions
articles.snippet: The SHRINCS proposal would let bitcoin transactions use larger, quantum-resistant approvals while preserving more network capacity than existing post-quantum signature designs.

articles.title: Binance co-founders CZ and Yi He adopted Simpsons cartoon aliases ‘Homer’ and ‘Marge’ in company meetings
articles.snippet: Yi, who is now the co-CEO of Binance alongside its other chief Richard Teng, still uses the name Marge in meetings and chats.

articles.title: Bitcoin below $79,000, XRP leads losses as traders start betting on a Fed hike
articles.snippet: Every major token except solana and BNB is flat or lower over 24 hours, with bitcoin holding a 14% weekly gain and XRP 28%.

articles.title: Lesser-tracked bitcoin market dynamic lends credibility to August surge to $80,000
articles.snippet: An indicator fundamental to understanding whether capital consistently moved in size to push prices higher is flashing green.

articles.title: SEC resurrecting U.S. crypto custody rule the previous administration failed to land
articles.snippet: In 2023, the regulator tried to narrowly restrict the places investment advisers could park clients' crypto assets, but the new approach is still shrouded in secrecy.
